title: Update Contents
description: currently it is expected, since we cannot delete a shadow dom, that the entire div containing it needs to be deleted and then restored. Would it be better to have the capability to just re-run the internals (source data again, clear table contents, reset view to upper left)?

title: Avoid ShadowDOM issue when recreating PagedTable
description:
When re-creating a `PagedTable` we reuse a DOM element that has already the ShadowDOM attached and the operation fails. Workaround is to give new DOM elements to the `PagedTable()` constructor, but this should be avoided.

Repro: Remove workaround from https://mlverse.github.io/pagedtablejs/examples/vue.html

title: Avoid iFrame in Vue.js doc example
description: This is more of an issue between `docsify` and `vue.js` where the content creation does not play nicely, current workaround is to use `<iframe>` which is not great.
